AgentAttributionRequest.description: The desktop Host asks Core to vouch for one Agent execution of a product Session.

AgentAttributionResponse.description:
An opaque credential that Core alone can verify. A caller presents it in the
Agent attribution header so content changes name the Session's Agent.

AgentBackendBinding.description:
Durable identity of the runtime family that owns an Agent conversation.
Backend-specific settings live behind their own stable identifiers instead
of accumulating nullable fields on Threads and Automations.

AgentBackendKind.description:
The runtime family that executed an attributed action. Attribution keeps
only the family: a Session may change provider configuration between Runs.

Stable, user-visible mutation scope. Incidental ranks and internal Document
heads deliberately remain outside this value.

token.description: Exact receipt replay may omit a token. A new mutation cannot.

AppToolOperationRequest.description: Host-only admission: the model chooses an opaque key, never a clock or operation envelope.

AuthorizedDeliveryPacket.description:
Authenticated connection transport artifact. Packets for the apply response
and durable stream may have different coverage but always reference the
same immutable manifest identity.

oneOf.description: The decision of an `AskFirst` Automation waiting in the Inbox, if any. At most one waits per Automation.

type.description: The runbook Page's current title; None without a runbook or when the Page is no longer active.

AutomationDueWorkPlan.description:
A Core-authored scheduling decision. Main owns sleeping and wake sources,
while the Automation Module remains the authority for durable due state.
